edges.reason: msg.sender drives the _isApprovedOrOwner authorization check in harvestMetal.
msg.sender drives per-ship ownership checks inside the harvestAllMetal loop.
msg.sender keys LAST_SHIP_PURCHASE_BLOCK and the balance/allowance purchase checks.
block.timestamp is stored as GENESIS_TIMESTAMP, making reward timing miner-influenced.
block.timestamp (now) is used as entropy in the attribute shuffle seed.
player parameter flows into the burn target.
Ship price parameter is scaled and used in unchecked arithmetic.
player parameter becomes the mint recipient.
Amount parameter is scaled and validated against the treasury balance.
bonus parameter overwrites the bonus pool.
numberOfShips drives price multiplication and stock subtraction.
owner parameter receives the newly minted ship.
id parameter selects the ship to harvest.
Caller-supplied blockNumber controls reward accrual and harvestBook state.
owner parameter selects the ship set to harvest.
Caller-supplied blockNumber controls bulk reward accrual.
id parameter selects the ship for pending metal computation.
Caller-supplied blockNumber is the reference point for pending metal.
burnMetalToShip performs raw addition on _bonus without SafeMath.
Unchecked sum is written into the _bonus state variable.
burnMetalToShip accumulates burned METAL into _burntMetal.
burnMetalToShip credits the treasury split.
restrictedMint decrements the treasury before minting.
setBonus overwrites _bonus.
getBonusNoDecimals reads and scales _bonus.
setMetalAddress assigns the MetalToken reference.
setMetalAddress flips the one-time wiring flag.
purchaseRandomShip mutates _shipsForSale.
purchaseRandomShip may increment _generation.
purchaseRandomShip updates _generationRestocks.
purchaseRandomShip reprices ships via _shipMetalPrice.
purchaseRandomShip records _shipMetalPricePrevious.
purchaseRandomShip advances _generationBlockStart.
purchaseRandomShip advances _restockBlockStart.
purchaseRandomShip mutates the offset accumulator.
purchaseRandomShip writes LAST_SHIP_PURCHASE_BLOCK for msg.sender.
purchaseRandomShip decrements stock with raw subtraction.
Unchecked subtraction result is stored in _shipsForSale.
purchaseRandomShip calls generateRandomShip per purchased ship.
generateRandomShip calls getRandomShipAttribute three times.
generateRandomShip pushes a new Ship struct into ships.
generateRandomShip increments ship_length.
getRandomShipAttribute pops from ATTRIBUTE_RNG.
harvestMetal queries getPendingMetal for the ship.
harvestAllMetal queries getPendingMetal per owned ship.
getPendingMetal calls getMetalBlockRewardMultiplier.
purchaseRandomShip uses the weekly reward multiplier for restock pricing.
harvestMetal performs an external setBonus call before finishing its state updates.
The external setBonus call can re-enter harvestMetal prior to ships[id] state updates.
harvestMetal performs an external restrictedMint call before finishing its state updates.
The external restrictedMint call can re-enter harvestMetal and double-harvest rewards.
harvestMetal accumulates metalHarvested with raw addition.
Unchecked accumulation is written back to the ship struct.
harvestAllMetal performs an external setBonus call during or after the loop.
The external setBonus call can re-enter harvestAllMetal before state finalization.
harvestAllMetal performs an external restrictedMint call after the loop.
The external restrictedMint call can re-enter harvestAllMetal and duplicate mints.
purchaseRandomShip calls the external MetalToken.burnMetalToShip mid-flow.
The external burnMetalToShip call can re-enter purchaseRandomShip before state finalization.

normalization_plan.reason: The player parameter only exists to feed the burn target inside burnMetalToShip.
The ship price parameter is consumed entirely by burnMetalToShip arithmetic.
The player parameter only selects the mint recipient in restrictedMint.
The amount parameter is consumed by the treasury check and mint inside restrictedMint.
The bonus parameter is only used to overwrite the bonus pool in setBonus.
The quantity parameter drives only the purchase logic of purchaseRandomShip.
The owner parameter is only the mint recipient inside generateRandomShip.
The ship id parameter selects the target of harvestMetal.
The caller-supplied block number only feeds reward math inside harvestMetal.
The owner parameter selects the ship set processed by harvestAllMetal.
The block number parameter only feeds reward math inside harvestAllMetal.
The ship id parameter selects the ship queried by getPendingMetal.
The block number parameter is the reference point used by getPendingMetal.
The returned id array is a temporary buffer local to purchaseRandomShip.
The pending amount local is transient state used only inside harvestMetal.
The accumulator local exists only during the harvestAllMetal loop.
The accumulator local is a scratch value inside getPendingMetal.
